pages.name: French Defense: Réti-Spielmann Attack
pages.notes: Plan 1 had an f4-f5 storm with the knight on f3 and 0-0 notation; plan 4 had Black trade light-squared bishops as if c8 could reach g2. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling in the overview.

pages.notes: Plan 1 had an Ne1-g2-f4 route; plan 2 had ...cxd4 with no white pawn on d4 and a ...b5-b4 route; plan 3 had a d2-f1-e3 route. Rewrote plans 1-3.

pages.notes: Plan 1 had an Nf1-g3-f5 route; plan 3 had a Qe1-h4 route. Rewrote both (the reviewer caught that the castled rook on f1 must move before a knight can use it).
